string-array.name: changelog_1_1_1
string-array.item: The pause button no longer reads like a square: the two bars now have a visible gap between them.
Your phone now goes quiet while the noise plays, and back to normal when you stop it. Alarms still get through.
The sleep timer counts in fives up to half an hour: 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 minutes, then 40, 50, 60, 90 and 120.

string-array.name: changelog_1_1_0
string-array.item: Your phone now goes quiet while the noise plays, and back to normal when you stop it. Alarms still get through: it uses the Do Not Disturb exceptions you already set.
Android only lets you grant that from its own settings, so the app explains it once and takes you there. There is a switch for it in Settings too.
The sleep timer counts in fives up to half an hour: 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 minutes, then 40, 50, 60, 90 and 120.

string-array.name: changelog_1_0_1
string-array.item: The arrows in the notification now do something: they move to the previous or next sound, without opening the app.
The progress bar is gone from the notification. The noise has no end for a bar to creep towards.
The sleep timer now counts in tens: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 minutes, plus 90 and 120. The button in the notification adds 10.

string-array.name: changelog_1_0
string-array.item: Four noises generated on your device — masking, pink, white and brown — with no loop you can notice and no compression artefacts.
The masking noise is shaped to cover conversation: 71 % of its energy sits where speech does, against brown noise\'s 9 %.
Plays as soon as you open the app, with the last sound you were listening to.
Sleep timer from 15 to 120 minutes, with a gradual fade out over the last minute.
Control it from the notification, with the app closed and the screen off. Pausing ends the session and clears the notification away.

resources.string: Silence the phone while it plays
A notification at three in the morning wakes you as surely as the noise you came here to cover. Sleep Noise can switch Do Not Disturb on while the sound plays, and off again when you stop it.
Your alarms are not affected, unless you have told Do Not Disturb otherwise: it keeps whatever exceptions you already set.
Android only lets this be granted from its own settings. Look for Sleep Noise in the list that opens.
